svg.text: R1 Hearthspire → Pebblebrook · 120 · grass, then the mill road · open from the start (the capital gate)
R2 Pebblebrook → Sunhaven · 160 · grass, then desert · open
R3 Sunhaven → Emberreach · 170 · desert, then a mountain pass · open; a raptor cliff shortcut later
R4 Emberreach → Hearthspire · 150 · the bun road: pass, then grass · the toll (three pieces)
R5 Hearthspire → Frostwick · 160 · grass, then snowfield · the north gate, shut until the flour tunnel
R6 Hearthspire → Saltspray · 160 · grass, then shore · the east gate, shut until the flour tunnel
R7 Saltspray → the islands · 90 · by boat · the boats, after the harbour is patched
